description: This source file implements a service for calculating estimate totals for a project. It defines data structures, helper functions for fetching default hours and rates, role-picking logic, and a main function 'calculate_totals' that aggregates hours and costs per item and per role based on database records.

classes.name: EstimateTotals
classes.description: Container for totals and rollups related to an estimate, including total hours, total cost, costs by role, and per-item summaries.

methods.name: Optional[float] _get_default_hours(db: Session, item_type: str, complexity: str)
methods.description: Fetch default hours for an item type and complexity from the database, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[float,str]] _get_rate_for_role(db: Session, role: str)
methods.description: Retrieve hourly rate and currency for a specified role from the RateCard table.

methods.name: str _pick_role_for_item(item: EstimateItem)
methods.description: Determine the default role for an estimate item based on its item type via simple mapping.

methods.name: EstimateTotals calculate_totals(db: Session, estimate_id: int)
methods.description: Compute total hours and costs for a given estimate ID, including per-role breakdown and item details, retrieving relevant data from the database.

ctags.name: _get_default_hours
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_default_hours(db: Session, item_type: str, complexity: str) -> Optional[float]:$/
